Add Stak Suite to Home Screen

Install this website like an app for quick access. Works offline-friendly in the browser.

Google Chrome (Android)
  1. Open Stak Suite in Chrome.
  2. Tap the ⋮ menu (top right).
  3. Tap Add to Home screen or Install app.
  4. Confirm the name → tap Add / Install.
  5. Open the new icon on your home screen anytime.

Tip: If you don’t see the option, update Chrome or try the address bar Install icon.

Safari (iPhone / iPad)
  1. Open Stak Suite in Safari (not Chrome on iOS).
  2. Tap the Share button □↑ at the bottom.
  3. Scroll and tap Add to Home Screen.
  4. Edit the name if you want → tap Add.
  5. Open the icon on your home screen to launch full screen.

Tip: “Add to Home Screen” only appears in Safari on iPhone/iPad.

After installing, use the same company portal email and password on every device. Staff, supervisors, and pastry chefs log in after opening the portal.
